verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local iOS Unix-like terminal, and AI-assisted git workflows are a plausible capability for a terminal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents git integration, AI features, or commit-message generation from staged changes. Bundled languages, pip and pkg are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated commit message suggestions based on my staged changes
